Hero.title: I build web systems from the database to the interface.
Hero.lead: End-to-end TypeScript specialist. I take products from zero to deploy — APIs in Node.js and NestJS, interfaces in React and Next.js, with a focus on clean architecture and measurable delivery.

facts.label: Currently
facts.note: Three systems built from scratch and shipped to production: benefits, AI-assisted quotes and accounting provisions.

facts.label: Impact
facts.note: Hours of manual work removed every month across the three systems — figures validated by the business teams.

facts.label: Method
facts.note: SDD and TDD as guardrails for AI-assisted development — written spec and defined tests before a single line.

Work.label: Work
Work.title: Three systems in production, each measured in hours given back.
Work.lead: Delivered under contract through Greenfive, placed at Ancar Ivanhoe. Scope, architecture and delivery end to end on every one.

projects.name: Benefits management
projects.desc: Platform built from scratch for requesting, approving and paying benefits across the group's 94 companies. Replaced spreadsheets and manual checking with a single auditable flow wired into finance.

projects.name: OCR and quoting agent
projects.desc: Agent that reads supplier quotes from PDFs and images, extracts and normalises the data, and returns pre-compared purchasing options for the group's malls. Savings measured by the business team itself.

projects.name: Contingency provisioning
projects.desc: Accounting system that calculates legal-case provisions by category, co-participation and affected companies — including the split with tenants — and posts the entries straight into JD Edwards.
